provider.hintDoubao: Doubao: use a model ID, or an endpoint ID created in the Volcano Ark console (ep- prefix)
provider.hintMoonshot: Kimi: models iterate fast — click "Fetch models" to see what's available
provider.hintOpenai: OpenAI: access from mainland China can be unstable; a proxy may be needed
provider.hintOpenrouter: OpenRouter: one key for every platform; model IDs carry vendor prefixes (e.g. google/gemini-2.5-flash)
provider.hintOllama: Ollama: local inference, no API key needed. Run ollama serve on this machine (default port 11434), pull a model with ollama pull, then click "Fetch models" to pick it. Note: context length comes from the Modelfile's num_ctx (the OpenAI-compatible endpoint cannot set it). Auto batching is capped for local inference — keep 1–2 threads and proofread the output.
provider.hintLlamacpp: llama.cpp: local inference, no auth by default. Start llama-server first (default 127.0.0.1:8080; use --ctx-size for context and --alias to give the model a readable name), then click "Fetch models" to pick it. Auto batching is capped for local inference — keep 1–2 threads and proofread the output.
provider.hintCustom: Custom: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Base URL + model name)

params.groupDesc: Lower temperature gives steadier output; batch size affects request size and streaming granularity
params.batchSizeAutoTooltip: When on, batch size = entries to translate / threads (rounded up) for full-thread throughput. Note: with few entries or many similar items in one batch (e.g. lots of alike config keys), the model may return the source text unchanged ("translation identical to source"); if that happens you'll be asked whether to clear and re-translate
params.batchSizeTooltip: Entries per request (1-200); translations are streamed batch by batch

glossary.groupDesc: Unify terms and style: the glossary locks proper-noun translations, prompts define the translator role and rules
glossary.extractTooltip: Before translating, let the AI extract a glossary of proper nouns from the entries to unify translations
glossary.customDescTip: Format: English → Chinese, e.g. Diamond → 钻石
glossary.customDesc: Custom glossary (unify terms, e.g. Diamond → 钻石; format: English → Chinese)
glossary.empty: No custom terms yet — add one with the button below

threading.warn: Parallel requests are more likely to hit provider rate limits (429); the app backs off and retries automatically. Pick threads and intervals based on your provider's limits — longer intervals are safer.
threading.intervalTooltip: Gap between requests within each thread — longer gaps are less likely to trigger rate limits
threading.packWarn: Translating several packs at once multiplies concurrency and makes rate limiting much more likely; all packs also share the per-thread request quota. Choose the pack count based on your provider's limits.

appearance.groupDesc: Export naming, close behavior and logging are independent and apply on save
appearance.closeBehaviorTip: "Minimize to tray": the close button only hides the window — restore or exit from the tray icon; your pack list and progress are kept
appearance.exportNamingTip: How exported files are named. Original = same name as the source file (no suffix); Original_zh_cn = source name plus a localization suffix; AI name = ask the model for a Chinese name during translation (small extra token cost), falling back to Original_zh_cn when unavailable.
appearance.autoLogTip: Records a log of this run in the app own data folder; API keys and other secrets are redacted. Turning it off only stops recording — existing logs are kept.

deepScan.fixedNote: Fixed: nesting depth 3 and text length 3-200 are enforced by the engine

desc.scopeJson: Text inside advancements, recipes and configs. Low noise, high value.
desc.scopeLang: .lang and .properties outside assets/lang (common in plugins). High value.
desc.scopeText: toml/ini/cfg/conf/yaml/yml/txt/md. Configs are valuable; txt/md docs add noise.
desc.scopeNested: Jars inside jars (jar-in-jar mods). Valuable, but bundled library text comes too.
desc.scopeClass: Parse hardcoded strings in the .class constant pool (player-visible messages, GUI titles, item names…); the main source of plugin messages, off by default for mods because of noise.
desc.skipMeta: META-INF, LICENSE, CHANGELOG and similar untranslatable content.
desc.skipLangfiles: Language files are handled by the normal parser; re-scanning duplicates entries, so this stays on.
desc.skipLibs: Skips bundled third-party libraries (bukkit/json/google/kotlin...) - about 8% pure noise removed in tests.
desc.onlySourceLocale: In multi-locale packs only English/Chinese count as source; other locales go to an unchecked group so German/Japanese is never treated as source.
desc.keepCjk: Any text containing Chinese is kept, protecting existing translations. Always on.
desc.dropSql: Strings starting with SQL keywords or containing SQL clauses (typical in data stores).
desc.dropDescriptor: JVM internals such as Lcom/a/B; or (Ljava/lang/String;)V.
desc.dropLog: Console-oriented lines (Failed / Could not / Loading / stack traces) rather than player-facing text.
desc.dropIdent: Keys, permission nodes and constants without spaces (e.g. griefprevention.claim.kick).
desc.classNeedsMarker: When on, code strings with color codes/placeholders or sentence shape go to "Messages" (checked by default); the rest go to "Code - other" (unchecked).

deepScan.customEmpty: No custom rules yet. Add an extension / glob / regex, or import a community profile.

deepScan.testHint: Pick or import a pack to preview the scan result with the current rules.
deepScan.testNote: The testbed uses the same engine and rules as real scans and follows the **current toggles in this dialog** — flips re-run instantly, no need to save first. Up to 30 samples are shown.
deepScan.testNoteTip: Same rules and parser; follows the current toggles — what you see is what a real scan gets
deepScan.groupDesc: Deep scan digs out embedded text beyond normal parsing (advancements, configs, code constants). Mods and plugins are configured separately; every rule can be toggled.
deepScan.groupHintTip: Uses the "Recommended" template: noisy rules off, message text pre-checked. Changes apply to later scans only.
deepScan.groupHint: The "Recommended" template is active by default: noisy rules are off and high-confidence message text is pre-checked. Switch to "Everything (legacy)" to restore the old behaviour. Rule changes apply to later scans; re-click the scan button on a pack to re-scan (existing translations are preserved).
